data.long_meaning: Sharika is the name of a goddess in Hindu mythology, who is often depicted as the goddess of wealth and prosperity. Her name comes from the Sanskrit word 'shri', meaning 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. Sharika is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and good fortune in Hinduism. The name Sharika carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sharika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Her most famous work is the Sanskrit composition 'Shringara-rahasya', a treatise on the art of love.
